contracts.claim: IWn.request returns a rejected Promise if electronBridge sender is absent or a supplied signal is already aborted. It inserts pending resolvers before invoking the sender. Rejection handled by the returned sender value’s .catch callback rejects and removes that pending entry. A synchronous sender invocation or .catch access/call error escapes this non-async request path without the selected rejection cleanup; the previously inserted entry is not removed there. A supplied signal adds local rejection and worker-request-cancel; selected Yt supplies none. The saved preload sender declaration is async, while actual external bridge receiver identity is unobserved.
contracts.parameterContract: Outer {type:worker-request,workerId,request:{enqueuedAtMs,id,method,params,trace}}.
contracts.stateOwner: IWn pending Map; browser bridge is optional external boundary.
contracts.resultContract: Promise settled by later message; delivery invoke is distinct from domain result.
contracts.errorContract: Absent sender and already-aborted signal return rejected Promises. Sender-returned Promise rejection handled by .catch disposes the signal listener, removes pending and rejects it. Synchronous sender/.catch errors propagate from non-async request without that cleanup; subsequent external cleanup or actual transport behavior is unknown.
contracts.cancellationContract: Generic conditional AbortSignal path exists; no observed or selected-call cancellation.
